Context: 2. Hostel Subsidy

Rate.The amount of ceiling of Hostel Subsidy is'{ 6,750 p.m. In order to claim reimbursement of Hostel Subsidy for an academic year, a similar certificate from the Head of Institution confirming that the child studied in the school will suffice, with additional requirement that the certificate should mention the amount of expenditure incurred by the Government servant towards lodging and boarding in the residential complex. In case such certificate cannot be obtained, self-attested copy of the report card
